profile_text: With a focus on transportation and storage solutions, this Düsseldorf-based firm has experienced rapid growth of 280% since its baseline, driven by its specialized services in travel management and logistics. Operating from its location at Mündelheimer Weg 10, the company has expanded its employee base to 19 in 2024, solidifying its position as a scaler in the industry. Its strategic location in Deutschland enables it to effectively cater to the regional market, contributing to its remarkable expansion.
